subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) These satellite channels are telecasting programmes all day and night. (b) Particularly young generations are affected very badly. (c) The most familiar channels are Sony Max, Zee Cinema, AXN, Shahara, Zee TV, Star Sports, Star Plus, Star Jalsha, Discovery, National Geography etc. (d) We are watching various programmes on satellite Channels. (e) The recent statistics shows that social violence has increased much more after introducing Satellite Channels. (f) The television is the most important medium of communication of thoughts and ideas. (g) We are enjoying these channels and gradually, they are getting into our culture. (h) But it has some bad effects too. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (f) + (h) + (d) + (a) + (c) + (e) + (g) + (b) Section B : Writing Test
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 125 — Holy Cross Girls' High School, Dhaka
